title: PatchCon: Patch-aware Weighted Supervised Contrastive Learning for Vulnerability Detection
title_zh: PatchCon：面向漏洞检测的补丁感知加权监督对比学习

paragraphs.en: PatchCon利用补丁配对作难负样本进行对比学习，显著提升函数级漏洞检测成对准确率。 Automated vulnerability detection is critical for securing modern software systems, yet existing learning-based approaches often treat functions as independent samples and underuse the supervision provided by vulnerability-fixing patches. In this paper, we propose PatchCon, a CodeBERT-based patch-aware contrastive learning model for function-level vulnerability detection. PatchCon jointly optimizes vulnerability classification and supervised contrastive learning, and treats vulnerable-patched function pairs as hard negatives with larger contrastive weights to capture subtle security-relevant differences introduced by fixes. To evaluate patch-level discrimination, we use two pairwise metrics that measure whether a model can correctly distinguish vulnerable functions from their patched counterparts. We evaluate PatchCon on PairVul-Linux through extensive experiments, including state-of-the-art comparisons, ablation studies, hyperparameter sensitivity analysis, and statistical significance testing. We also conduct fine-grained analyses by Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) type, function length, and patch size, and further evaluate PatchCon on Linux kernel vulnerabilities disclosed after the training data cutoff. On PairVul-Linux, PatchCon outperforms representative pretrained code models and contrastive learning baselines on both classification and pairwise metrics, improves pairwise accuracy over the strongest reproduced baseline from 0.2060 to 0.3264, and achieves pairwise accuracy comparable to that of a GPT-4o-based large language model (LLM) method at a substantially lower cost. Among the reproduced models, PatchCon also achieves the highest pairwise accuracy on test pairs from Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) entries unseen during training and on newly disclosed vulnerabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化漏洞检测对于保障现代软件系统的安全至关重要，然而现有的基于学习的方法往往将函数视为独立样本，未能充分利用漏洞修复补丁所提供的监督信息。PatchCon利用补丁配对作难负样本进行对比学习，显著提升函数级漏洞检测的成对准确率。 在本文中，我们提出PatchCon，一种基于CodeBERT的补丁感知对比学习模型，用于函数级漏洞检测。 PatchCon联合优化漏洞分类与有监督对比学习，并将漏洞函数—修复后函数的配对视为具有更大对比权重的难负样本，以捕捉修复所引入的细微安全相关差异。 为了评估补丁级别的判别能力，我们采用两种成对指标，衡量模型能否正确区分漏洞函数与其修复后的对应函数。 我们在PairVul-Linux上通过大量实验评估PatchCon，包括与最先进方法的对比、消融实验、超参数敏感性分析以及统计显著性检验。 我们还按通用缺陷枚举（CWE）类型、函数长度和补丁大小进行了细粒度分析，并进一步在训练数据截止日期之后披露的Linux内核漏洞上评估PatchCon。 在PairVul-Linux上，PatchCon在分类指标和成对指标上均优于具有代表性的预训练代码模型和对比学习基线，将成对准确率相对最强的复现基线从0.2060提升至0.3264，并以显著更低的成本取得了与基于GPT-4o的大语言模型（LLM）方法相当的成对准确率。 在复现的模型中，PatchCon在训练中未见过的通用漏洞披露（CVE）条目对应的测试配对以及新披露的漏洞上，也取得了最高的成对准确率。
